source.author: verg
source.text: Praeterea, si qua est Heleno prudentia, vati si qua fides, animum si veris implet Apollo, unum illud tibi, nate dea, proque omnibus unum praedicam, et repetens iterumque iterumque monebo:
source.text_original: 'Praeterea, si qua est Heleno prudentia, vati / si qua fides, animum si veris implet Apollo, / unum illud tibi, nate dea, proque omnibus unum / praedicam, et repetens iterumque iterumque monebo: /
source.text_english: Moreover, if Helenus has any wisdom, if a prophet is worthy of any trust, if Apollo fills my mind with truth, this one thing alone I shall proclaim to you, son of a goddess, this one thing in place of all, and I shall warn you again and again, repeating it over and over:

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: unum illud tibi, nata deo, proque omnibus unum praedicam et repetens iterumque iterumque monebo, ut animum tuum sacrae lectionis amore occupes nec in bona terra pectoris tui sementem lolii auenarumque suscipias, ne dormiente patre familias qui est , id est animus, deo semper adhaerens inimicus homo zizania superseminet, sed semper loquaris: in noctibus quaesiui, quem dilexit anima mea.
reuse.text_original: (unum) illud tibi, nata deo, proque omnibus unum praedicam et repetens iterumque iterumque monebo, ut animum tuum sacrae lectionis amore occupes nec in bona terra pectoris tui sementem lolii auenarumque suscipias, ne dormiente patre familias — qui est νοῦς, id est animus, deo semper adhaerens — inimicus homo zizania superseminet, sed semper loquaris: in noctibus quaesiui, quem dilexit anima mea.
reuse.text_english: I will proclaim and again and again remind you of this one thing, daughter born of God and one for all: occupy your mind with a love of sacred reading, and do not let the good soil of your heart receive the sowing of darnel and oats, lest, while the householder who is there, that is, your mind, is asleep, with God ever cleaving to it, the enemy man sow tares over it; but always say: In the nights I sought him whom my soul loved.
